title: WCL Asst. Foreman (Electrical) — Mock 14
pattern: WCL Asst. Foreman (Electrical) CBT (100 Q · 100 marks · 120 min · no −ve)

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Emergency diesel generator in a power station provides:
questions.solution: EDG: starts during blackout, powers essential loads

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Binary cycle geothermal plant uses:
options: Secondary working fluid with lower boiling point
questions.solution: Binary: heat exchange with organic fluid (isobutane, isopentane)

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The function of a steam trap in a power plant is to:
questions.solution: Steam trap: discharges condensate, prevents steam loss

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A synchronous condenser is a:
options: Synchronous motor running unloaded for pf correction
questions.solution: Synch condenser: overexcited synchronous motor, supplies VARs

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Peak demand is met by:
options: Gas turbines, pumped hydro, or diesel generators
questions.solution: Peaking: fast-start units (GT, pumped storage, diesel)

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Pumped storage hydro stores energy by:
options: Pumping water to upper reservoir during off-peak
questions.solution: Pumped storage: pump up at night, generate at peak

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Cogeneration means:
options: Combined heat and power from same fuel
questions.solution: CHP: useful heat + electricity from one fuel source

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Load factor of a power station is:
questions.solution: LF = Avg demand / Peak demand

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Plant use factor is:
questions.solution: Use factor = actual energy / (rated capacity x operating time)

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Availability factor of a power plant:
options: Hours available / Total hours in period
questions.solution: Availability = time available to generate / total time

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Specific fuel consumption of thermal plant is:
questions.solution: Thermal: ~0.3-0.7 kg coal per kWh depending on plant efficiency

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Combined cycle gas turbine (CCGT) plant achieves efficiency of:
questions.solution: CCGT: gas turbine + steam turbine = 55-62% efficiency

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Gas turbine in Brayton cycle uses which working fluid?
questions.solution: Brayton: air/gas as working fluid

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The function of an exciter in alternator is to:
options: Supply DC field current to rotor winding
questions.solution: Exciter: provides DC to rotor for magnetic field

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Damper windings in alternator prevent:
questions.solution: Damper windings: copper bars in rotor pole face, damp oscillations

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Alternator voltage regulation depends on:
options: Load current, power factor, and synchronous reactance
Neither the first nor the second option
questions.solution: Regulation = f(E, V, load current, PF, Xs)

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Alternator runs at leading PF when:
questions.solution: Overexcited: acts as source of VARs (capacitor-like)

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A standby generator should start within:
questions.solution: Emergency: 10-15 seconds start to full load

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The slip of an induction generator is:
questions.solution: Induction gen: runs above synchronous speed, negative slip

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A gas insulated substation (GIS) occupies __ of space compared to AIS:
questions.solution: GIS: ~10-15% of AIS footprint

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The function of an isolator is to:
options: Provide visible break for maintenance safety
questions.solution: Isolator: visible isolation point, operated on no-load

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Step-up transformer at power station increases voltage for:
questions.solution: Step-up: higher voltage -> lower current -> lower I²R losses

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Hydroelectric power station has:
options: Low running cost and long life
questions.solution: Hydro: low running cost, long life, renewable

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The load curve of a power station shows:
questions.solution: Load curve: MW demand plotted against time

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Most efficient power plant is:
questions.solution: Hydro: 90%+ turbine-generator efficiency

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The capacity of a power station is measured in:
questions.solution: Capacity: MW (active) or MVA (apparent)

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A voltage stabilizer maintains:
options: Constant output voltage despite input variation
questions.solution: Stabilizer: regulates voltage within ±1%

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Rotary UPS uses:
questions.solution: Rotary UPS: flywheel + motor-generator for clean power

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Static UPS uses:
questions.solution: Static UPS: battery + inverter electronics

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Bus transfer scheme in power station:
options: Shifts load from one bus to another without interruption
questions.solution: Bus transfer: seamless load transfer during maintenance

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Maximum demand indicator in energy meter records:
options: Highest kW or kVA during billing period
questions.solution: MDI: registers peak demand for tariff calculation

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Tariff based on maximum demand and energy consumed is called:
questions.solution: Two-part: fixed charge (MD) + variable charge (kWh)

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Time-of-day (TOD) tariff charges different rates for:
options: The statement is partially correct but incomplete
questions.solution: TOD: higher rate at peak, lower off-peak to shift demand

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Numerical relay uses DSP to:
options: Process sampled signals for protection algorithms
questions.solution: DSP: digital signal processing for fast fault detection

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Transformer differential protection compares:
questions.solution: Diff: I1/I2 ratio vs CT ratio, operates on mismatch

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Restricted Earth Fault (REF) protection protects:
questions.solution: REF: sensitive earth fault protection for transformer star winding

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: High impedance bus protection principle:
options: All CTs in parallel with matching burden
questions.solution: High-Z: parallel CTs, voltage across stabilizing resistor

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Distance relay zone 1 typically covers:
questions.solution: Zone 1: 80% of line length (instantaneous, no overreach)

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Distance relay zone 2 covers:
questions.solution: Zone 2: 100% line + 20% into next line (time delayed)

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Generator stator protection includes:
options: Differential, earth fault, interturn, stator core
Both the first and second options
Neither the first nor the second option
questions.solution: Stator: diff (phase faults), 64 (earth), interturn, core temp

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Rotor earth fault protection uses:
options: AC injection or DC injection method
questions.solution: Rotor earth: AC/DC injection detects insulation failure

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Motor thermal overload protection uses:
questions.solution: Thermal: models motor heating from I²t losses

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Auto-reclosing scheme in transmission lines:
options: Quickly re-closes CB after transient fault clearance
questions.solution: Auto-reclose: recloses within 0.3-1s for transient faults

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Synchrophasors are used for:
options: Wide area monitoring and stability assessment
questions.solution: PMU/synchrophasor: GPS-synchronized voltage/current phasors

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Breaker failure relay operates when:
options: Primary CB fails to clear fault within time
questions.solution: BFR: backup protection if primary CB stuck

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Scheme intertripping means:
options: Sending trip signal to remote end of line
questions.solution: Intertripping (transfer trip): ensures both ends of line trip

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A relay with IDMT characteristic has:
options: Operating time inversely proportional to fault current
questions.solution: IDMT: higher fault current = faster operation

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Very inverse IDMT characteristic is used for:
questions.solution: Very inverse: steeper curve for long feeder discrimination

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Extremely inverse IDMT is used for:
questions.solution: Extremely inverse: matches fuse characteristics

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Under-frequency relay operates when frequency drops below:
questions.solution: UFR: load shedding to restore frequency balance

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Rate of change of frequency (ROCOF) relay detects:
questions.solution: ROCOF: detects disconnection from grid (islanding)

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Negative sequence relay protects against:
options: Phase unbalance and single-phasing of motors
questions.solution: Neg seq: detects unbalanced conditions that cause rotor heating

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Out-of-step (pole slip) protection operates when:
questions.solution: OOT: detects pole slipping, separates generator from grid

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Loss of excitation protection uses:
options: Offset mho relay on impedance plane
questions.solution: LOE: mho relay detects impedance entering relay zone

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Thermal image protection for transformer:
options: Monitors top oil and winding hot spot temperature
questions.solution: Thermal image: models transformer heating, predicts hot spot

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Dissolved Gas Analysis (DGA) of transformer oil detects:
questions.solution: DGA: H2, CH4, C2H2, C2H4 patterns indicate fault type

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Buchholz relay operation indicates:
options: Internal transformer fault with gas/ oil flow
questions.solution: Buchholz: gas accumulation or oil surge -> alarm or trip

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Sudden pressure relay in transformer detects:
options: Rapid pressure rise from internal fault
questions.solution: SPR: detects dv/dt of pressure rise (internal arc)

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Overfluxing (V/f) protection in transformer prevents:
options: Core saturation from excessive voltage or low frequency
questions.solution: V/f: prevents core saturation, overheating, and damage

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Motor starting current is typically:
questions.solution: DOL start: 5-8x FL current

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Star-delta starter reduces starting current to:
questions.solution: Star-delta: starting current = 1/3 of DOL

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Soft starter reduces starting current by:
questions.solution: Soft start: thyristor phase angle control of voltage

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: VFD motor starting current is typically:
questions.solution: VFD start: current limited, smooth acceleration

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Earth fault relay for motor is connected in:
questions.solution: Residual: 3I0, sensitive earth fault detection

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Negative sequence voltage relay detects:
questions.solution: Neg seq V: detects unbalanced supply voltage

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Power swing blocking in distance relay:
options: Prevents relay operation during power oscillations
questions.solution: PSB: distinguishes power swing from fault for stability

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Teleprotection sends trip signals via:
questions.solution: Teleprotection: fast inter-trip via telecom channel

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: IEC 61850 is a standard for:
questions.solution: IEC 61850: Ethernet-based substation automation protocol

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: GOOSE message in IEC 61850 is used for:
questions.solution: GOOSE: Generic Object Oriented Substation Event (fast tripping)

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: MMS in IEC 61850 is used for:
questions.solution: MMS: Manufacturing Message Specification for SCADA

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Bay controller in substation automation performs:
options: Local control, interlocking, and measurement for one bay
questions.solution: Bay controller: per-bay intelligent electronic device (IED)

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Merging unit in process bus converts:
options: CT/PT analog signals to digital samples
questions.solution: MU: digitizes CT/PT signals per IEC 61850-9-2

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Process bus in substation replaces:
options: Copper wiring from CTs/PTs to relays with fiber optic
questions.solution: Process bus: fiber optic replaces copper analog wiring

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Station bus in substation connects:
questions.solution: Station bus: Ethernet network connecting all IEDs

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Circuit breaker condition monitoring checks:
options: Contact wear, SF6 pressure, operating mechanism health
This is theoretically possible but impractical
questions.solution: CBM: monitors contact R, gas pressure, trip coil health

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Partial discharge monitoring in cables detects:
questions.solution: PD: early detection of insulation defects in HV equipment

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Frequency response analysis (FRA) of transformer detects:
questions.solution: SFRA: compares frequency response to detect winding movement

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Partial discharge in GIS is detected by:
questions.solution: UHF/acoustic: detects PD in SF6 insulated equipment

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Dynamic line rating (DLR) of OHL considers:
options: Real-time weather (wind, temp, solar) for actual ampacity
questions.solution: DLR: uses weather to calculate actual conductor capacity

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Flexible AC Transmission System (FACTS) devices include:
options: This applies only in specific conditions
Neither the first nor the second option
Both the first and second options
questions.solution: FACTS: power electronics for transmission control

questions.solution: OC = surface/opencast mining

questions.solution: Gondwana: ~90% of India's coal

questions.stem: The Ministry of Coal is headed by:

questions.solution: Underground coal gasification tried in Jharkhand

Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha only

questions.stem: ISRO headquarters is at:

questions.stem: Mangalyaan (Mars Orbiter Mission) was launched in:

questions.stem: India's first nuclear test was conducted at:

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: If a person covers 10 km in 2 hours, how far will they cover in 5 hours at the same speed?
questions.solution: Speed = 5 km/h. Distance = 5 × 5 = 25 km

questions.stem: Divide ₹1200 among A, B, C in the ratio 3:5:4.

questions.subject: General Awareness

questions.solution: Relative speed = 60 - 40 = 20 km/h. Time = 100/20 = 5 hours
